review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; model identity visible; original rubric

errors.quote: This controls for how much indicator is present.
errors.issue: The resting indicator/reference ratio is only an optical proxy without independent calibration of baseline calcium, reference abundance and differential attenuation. It cannot directly control molecular abundance.

These kinetics and neuropil coefficients are obtained using paired electrophysiology, but no explicit held-out blocks/preparations separate fitting from reporting. Blinding the detector after fitting does not validate transfer to new cells without their electrical labels.

errors.quote: Flag and exclude epochs where residual motion correlation with the GECI signal exceeds a pre-set bound.
errors.issue: True movement-related neural activity can correlate with motion. Excluding on the functional outcome can remove genuine responses and error-prone epochs. Gate on validated registration recoverability and report retained/excluded performance, using ephys to test signal preservation.

errors.quote: rate of detected "events" with no corresponding ephys spike
errors.issue: Define the time denominator, one-to-one temporal tolerance, duplicate-event handling and negatives beyond earlier calcium decay. Otherwise this rate and its ROC-style curve are not reproducibly specified.

errors.quote: spine claims inherit somatic calibration plus correction controls
errors.issue: The explicit lack-of-local-ground-truth caveat is good, but somatic calibration does not transfer to local spine spikes/synaptic calcium. Report optical spine responses and associations only unless a local validation is supplied.

rationale: Good paired acquisition, per-cell kinetics, expression-stratified modeling and motion challenges. Independent validation, expression measurement, motion-related selection and explicit event metrics need substantial correction.
reference_guardrails: Personally read every full received final answer and the exact question, packet, complete frozen reference and curator operational extension. Recovered tool-truncated passages before scoring. No hidden reasoning, paid judge or new candidate generation.
Original first-round rubric only. New user-requested 10/5 deductions will be formalized and applied separately only after this round is complete.

Unknown indicator identities, spike counts, rates and thresholds may be calibrated. Do not require an invented historical recipe or arbitrary universal numeric cutoffs; judge calibration procedures and operational inferential validity.

Somatic electrical spikes ground somatic spike inference, not local spine synaptic calcium. A spine event without a somatic spike may be real. Calcium without a spike can still be a false positive for the declared somatic-spike output.

Blank stimulation is not electrical silence. Silent periods may retain calcium from previous spikes. Use calibrated temporal windows, matching and explicit denominators; false discovery proportion is not true-negative-based FPR.

Reference intensity ratios are conditional optical proxies, not automatic expression concentrations. Baseline calcium, reference abundance and spectral attenuation matter. A 2D channel alone cannot reconstruct arbitrary 3D motion.
Motion/neuropil correlations can include genuine neural activity. Validate correction against paired ground truth and structural recoverability rather than excluding on desired functional outcomes.

Maintain saturation and poor inference as performance failures. Report unavailable technical intervals and operating-range coverage separately. Never tune validation preprocessing using its electrical labels unless an explicitly separate per-cell calibration protocol is the claimed deployment.

New-neuron and new-animal validation differ from held-out trials in a calibrated cell. Cells/trials/spines must retain animal and parent-cell clustering. No actual experiment or raw-data pipeline was executed.

Reviewer inspected the primary 2013 publisher abstract and figure titles, plus indexed primary spike-inference benchmark excerpts; full historical Methods and supplements were not audited. Historical numeric details are not claimed.

review_sources.scope: Publisher abstract and figure titles only; no complete source-methods audit.
